Definition: causing to howl, i.e. an oppressor
BiblicalUsage: The oppressor is the one who made God's people howl. In Babylon the captives were asked for a song by those who carried them away, and by those who wasted them, who required mirth in the strange land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse names the cruelty exactly: the captors did not only take the singers away, they demanded a song.
